title: Animated circle-to-signature reveal
slide_intent: Show the circle identity forming over time because motion can make the relationship between one primitive and the recognizable signature perceptible.
strategic_value: A brief reveal can connect geometric simplicity with brand recognition.
demonstration: A short black-ground animation moves from a small circular trace to a filled circle, resolves into the paired-color signature, then returns toward a single circle.
practical_value: Inspect the full local 5.2-second clip; use the PNG only as a representative still.
